name: Weather Radar
author: Eduardo Dalle Cort
description: Live weather radar map in the Omarchy bar, with optional storm alerts for your location.

barWidget.description: Weather radar map with a two-hour loop, plus optional alerts when precipitation approaches.

schema.label: Storm alerts
schema.description: Notify when precipitation is detected within the alert radius. Also toggleable from the panel.

schema.label: Alert radius (km)
schema.description: How far out to watch, and with it how far ahead to look: storms travel 40-60 km/h, so 100 km is roughly two hours of warning. The panel offers the common values; any step of 25 works here.

schema.label: Alert threshold
schema.description: Minimum echo intensity worth a notification.

schema.label: Colour scheme
schema.description: Radar palette. NEXRAD Level III matches what most broadcast meteorologists show.

schema.label: Default zoom
schema.description: Zoom the map opens at. Past level 7 the base map keeps sharpening while the radar is scaled up, since that is where the radar data runs out.

schema.label: Smooth radar
schema.description: Blend the radar image instead of showing hard pixel edges.

schema.label: Show status text in bar
schema.description: Print the nearest echo next to the bar icon. Requires storm alerts to be on, since that is what polls.
